notes.title: The Hidden Room V2.2.1 is now available!
notes.content:
Hey there!
The Hidden Room V2.2.1 is now available!
V2.2.1 is the last update of this game. 
We would like to take this opportunity to thank all of you for the support shown in these 2 years. The development of The Hidden Room started in May 2021 as a small project that after the release on 14 October 2021, turned out to be something bigger than we expected. This couldn't have happened without you. But it's not over yet. As already said, we're now completely focused on the development of The Hidden Room - Pyramid and we hope to share more info in September and start a new journey with the release soon.

Changelog:

The framerate of the game is now more stable and now locked to max 60FPS to avoid hardware running at max
Increased lighting in the basement
Minor UI improvements
Fixed an issue where in some cases Italian strings would appear when the game was set in English
Fixed an issue with some achievements not unlocking correctly
Fixed an issue with some collisions
Fixed various issues with the Italian translation
Fixed texture issues with the books in the livingroom
Fixed an issue with the stairs to the basement
Fixed minor issues with English translation

Once again, thank you

notes.title: The Hidden Room - June Development Update
notes.content:
Hey there!

Welcome to this Development Update. In this post we're going to summarize all the upcoming updates to The Hidden Room.

[h1]The Hidden Room - V2.2 Update[/h1]
We're almost ready to release V2.2 for The Hidden Room. This new update will be the last content update that The Hidden Room will receive. We're going to focus development only on The Hidden Room - Pyramid after releasing this update. We're still going to release bug fixes if necessary.

V2.2 will include a new feature called: "Puzzle Helper". This new feature will allow players to get some tips if they're stuck on a particular puzzle. You will find a button in the puzzle UI and some tips will be provided. This is the main feature coming to V2.2. The full changelog will be posted a few days before the release, on June 10th.

We're also preparing something that will be released for both games (The Hidden Room and The Hidden Room - Pyramid), but we will give more info as soon as we're ready.

Thank you

tags.feature: This new feature will allow players to get some tips if they're stuck on a particular puzzle.

notes.title: The Hidden Room V2.1 is now available!
notes.content:
Hey there!
The Hidden Room V2.1 is now available!
V2.0 was supposed to be the last major version that the game would have received, but then we thought about some improvements that the game could receive and then we decided to release V2.1!

[h1]The Hidden Room - Pyramid is now a game![/h1]

As already announced, The Hidden Room - Pyramid will not be a DLC anymore, but a game instead! More information on a new release date and more announcements, will be posted in the new store page. You can find the new store page and wishlist the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287130/

But now, let's see V2.1 changelog!

[h1]Steam Deck Compatibility info[/h1]

The game currently runs on the Steam Deck. This update adds Controller Support, so it will improve the Steam Deck compatibility overall. UI Elements will require to use touchscreen. In order to open the keyboard on the Steam Deck, use the STEAM + X combination. More improvements will come in the future.

[h1]New Features & Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Steam Deck support improved
[*]Added Controller Support
[*]Added a new way to save achievements progress. This new system allows us to create more and better achievements in current and future projects!
[*]Added 1 new achievement, that you can get in Speedrun mode.
[*]Engine Upgrade
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added "Latest patchnotes" button in-game to view the latest patchnotes
[*]Fixed an issue with different achievements that weren't unlocking in Speedrun Mode
[*]Multiple small bug fixes
[*]Various small UI improvements
[/list]

[h1]New game?[/h1]

We are currently starting development on our next game. We will prioritize the development of The Hidden Room - Pyramid first, and then focus on the development of the new game. More details will be announced in the next months.

As usual, if you have any problem please create a Steam Discussion or join our Discord Server.

Thank you for all of the support and see you soon!

notes.title: The Hidden Room 2.0 now available
notes.content:
Hey there everyone!
The Hidden Room 2.0 is now available! This will be the last content update for the game, which means that new content and features won't be added in the future.
Below you can also find what's next and our next plans for future projects

[h1]The Hidden Room 2.0 Changelog[/h1]

[b][h2]New Content & Features[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Added new gamemode: "Speedrun". You can submit your time and a clip of your speedrun in our [b]Discord Server[/b]!
[*]Added Steam Remote Play Together. More info: https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay
[*]Added new achievements! (unlockable in the new Speedrun mode)
[/list]
[b][h2]Changes & Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*]Improved interactions with items
[*]Performance improvements
[*]Fixed various small issues
[*]UI Improvements
[*]Fixed some issue with lighting in the basement
[*]English translation completely rewritten
[*]Language Selector reworked
[*]Textboxes will automatically focus instead of clicking on them every time
[*]Removed French language
[/list]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We will continue development for our DLC, and we will release it soon. We are also in the early development for a new game. More info on that later this year.

Thanks for your support and see you soon,
Mario and Emanuele

notes.title: More details on: "The Hidden Room - Pyramid"
notes.content:
[h1]March 2023 Update[/h1]

The Hidden Room - Pyramid will not be a DLC anymore, but it will be a separate game instead. This is the new link to the store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287130/The_Hidden_Room__Pyramid/?utm_campaign=thrp_thr_dlcnov2021post


Hey there everyone!
Today we would like to announce more details on the upcoming DLC for the game. As you might already know the DLC name is: "The Hidden Room - Pyramid", and as the name says, it will be set in a pyramid. 
The DLC will contain a new map, new puzzles and much more!
We also have plans on releasing multiplayer that will be included in the DLC, but nothing is confirmed so stay tuned!
We will be running some playtests sessions a few weeks before the release of the DLC to receive feedback. We will open playtests registrations, and give more info on them soon.

Have a great day!
Mario

[*]Italian

Have fun!
